title: Origin story: Quetzalcoatl
description: Quetzalcoatl was the feathered serpent god of wind and wisdom, who descended to the underworld to recover the bones of past humanity and ground them into the flour of new life. He gave mankind maize and the calendar, and opposed human sacrifice — departing eastward across the sea with a promise to return.
